decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to control the game through disruption and removal spells, while also utilizing powerful creatures like Ketramose, the New Dawn and Abhorrent Oculus to close out the game. The deck also includes draw spells and graveyard recursion to maintain card advantage and resilience. By combining efficient removal, counter spells, and strong creatures, this deck aims to outlast and overwhelm opponents in a long game, taking advantage of its control elements to dictate the pace of the match.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach and Grinding Station to combo off and win the game quickly. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble are key pieces to help facilitate the combo by recurring artifacts from the graveyard. The deck also contains several other powerful cards such as Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Urza's Saga to help control the board and find key pieces of the combo. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent.

This combo deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker early in the game. Utilizing cards like Persist and Witherbloom Command to generate additional value, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a strong board presence. The inclusion of cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push helps control the opponent's game plan while cards like Lightning Bolt provide additional reach to finish off the opponent. The deck showcases a blend of creativity and calculated combos to outmaneuver opponents in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures with different abilities to create powerful synergies and combos. It utilizes cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Dredger's Insight to generate value and card advantage, while using Chord of Calling to tutor for key creatures. The toolbox approach allows for flexibility in adapting to different situations and opponents. The deck also includes cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Young Wolf to provide resilience and board presence. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue opponents through a combination of creature interactions and combo potential.

The deck focuses on utilizing land ramp and bounce effects to quickly assemble the powerful combo of Primeval Titan and Amulet of Vigor, allowing for explosive plays and multiple land drops in a turn. By efficiently tutoring for key pieces with cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Expedition Map, the deck aims to ramp into powerful threats like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Lotus Field to overwhelm opponents with a burst of damage or a massive board presence. The deck also includes utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Mirrorpool to further enhance its versatility and resilience.

The deck focuses on ramping up quickly with cards like Arboreal Grazer and Amulet of Vigor to play Primeval Titan and combo off with Scapeshift or landfall triggers from Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. It utilizes lands like Urza's Saga and Lotus Field to generate additional mana and ensure consistency in finding key pieces, while also having the flexibility to tutor for specific cards with Expedition Map and Tolaria West. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful land-based combos and quickly close out the game with a large Titan or Valakut triggers.

This modern deck focuses on a fast-paced aggressive strategy combined with the ability to repeatedly "blink" or exile and return creatures for advantages. With cards like Flickerwisp and Overlord of the Balemurk, players can constantly disrupt their opponent's board state while applying pressure with powerful creatures like Solitude and Emperor of Bones. The deck also includes cards like Prismatic Ending and Relic of Progenitus to control the opponent's resources. By efficiently utilizing the blink mechanic, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure a quick victory.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the Breach combo engine to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard, generating infinite loops or powerful synergies. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provide card advantage and recursion, while cards like Underworld Breach and Mishra's Bauble enable the combo pieces to come together quickly. Grinding Station and Malevolent Rumble can then be used to finish off the opponent by milling their deck or dealing damage. The deck aims to be fast and consistent, with the potential for explosive turns and game-winning plays.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on generating fast aggressive pressure with key cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. It supports its aggro strategy with efficient removal spells like Chained to the Rocks and Galvanic Discharge, while also providing some card advantage and token generation with cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Ocelot Pride. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently, utilizing a mix of creatures, removal, and burn spells to maintain board control and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively build a board presence with powerful creatures like Guide of Souls, Ocelot Pride, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. Utilizing cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Goblin Bombardment for additional damage and removal, while controlling the opponent's strategy with cards like Static Prison and Arena of Glory. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient threats, while also maintaining a level of control and disruption with cards like Ranger-Captain of Eos and Thraben Charm.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble a combo involving Broodscale Bloodchief and Blade of the Bloodchief to generate a powerful board state and overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes support cards such as Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command to control the board while setting up the combo pieces. Additionally, the deck utilizes Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga to ramp up mana quickly and bring out key threats like Emrakul, the Promised End. The goal is to outvalue and outpace the opponent through a combination of powerful creatures and disruptive spells.

This deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with blink effects to maximize value. By utilizing cards like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate, players can repeatedly trigger powerful enter-the-battlefield effects like Solitude and Ketramose, the New Dawn. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of creatures, removal spells, and blink effects, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with strong creature synergies and efficient removal.

The main focus of this Merfolk aggro deck is to quickly ramp up creature presence on the board and overwhelm the opponent with a steady stream of attackers. By utilizing cards like Aether Vial and Lord of Atlantis to provide buffs to Merfolk creatures, as well as disruption spells like Force of Negation and Sink into Stupor to control the opponent's plays, this deck aims to maintain a strong tempo and dominate the battlefield. With a mix of creature support, control elements, and tribal synergy, this deck is designed for aggressive and efficient gameplay.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures while utilizing blink effects to get additional value from enter the battlefield abilities. By flickering creatures like Recruiter of the Guard and Flickerwisp, the deck can search for key cards or disrupt the opponent's board state. Aether Vial and Ephemerate are essential in maintaining tempo and protecting against removal. The deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent through a combination of efficient creatures and disruptive plays.

This deck focuses on creating a loop of sacrificing creatures and bringing them back from the graveyard to generate value and eventually close out the game with a mass sacrifice effect. It utilizes cards like Bloodghast, Gravecrawler, and Stitcher's Supplier to fuel the graveyard, while cards like Malevolent Rumble and Marionette Apprentice deal damage to the opponent based on the number of sacrificed creatures. The deck aims to assemble the combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful finish.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The deck uses a combination of creatures like Scion of Draco, Territorial Kavu, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding provide additional support to boost the power of the creatures. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize.
